faq.title: FAQ — compliance
faq.q1: Is the simulation a binding offer?
faq.a1: No. It is an indicative estimate with an APR starting from, excluding insurance/fees. The binding offer (SECCI) is issued only after KYC, scoring and human approval, subject to acceptance.
faq.a2: The engine recommends (APPROVE/REJECT/CONDITIONAL), the ADMIN decides. An exceptional waiver requires a written reason + audit; above the threshold, SUPER_ADMIN approval.
faq.a3: FR, EN, NL, DE — interfaces, emails, PDFs, notifications. Default locale is FR (BE), extensible per country.
faq.a4: EU only, encrypted. Kept per country rule (configurable, e.g. 10 years for BE KYC). Access, rectification and erasure supported.
